### Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. to Host Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Conference Call


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/493887674/files/doc_news/Madison-Square-Garden-Entertainment-Corp--to-Host-Fiscal-2027-First-Quarter-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (NYSE:[MSGE](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.msgentertainment.com%2Fstock-info%2F&esheet=54630812&newsitemid=20261029983138&lan=en-US&anchor=MSGE&index=1&md5=ef0b958ecf584d2c2827625719cc3c7d) ) will host a conference call to discuss results for its fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The Company will issue a press release reporting its results prior to the market opening.


To participate via telephone, please dial 833-461-5787 with the conference ID number 910557469 approximately 10 minutes prior to the call. The call will also be available via webcast at[investor.msgentertainment.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.msgentertainment.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54630812&newsitemid=20261029983138&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.msgentertainment.com&index=2&md5=656d2d16145ab0f24fcd630f47d62d90) under the heading “Events.”


For those who are unable to participate on the conference call, you may access a replay of the webcast on the website from 1:30 p.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.


**About Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp.**


Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the *Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes* , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at[www.msgentertainment.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.msgentertainment.com&esheet=54630812&newsitemid=20261029983138&lan=en-US&anchor=www.msgentertainment.com&index=3&md5=f0b6f239919bde3bea64b0b3edd09916) .
